scope: same-equation 600 m moving-child versus oversized stationary Nimbus reference with inherited v5 thresholds, geometry, aperture, and trusted-interior containment amendment

trusted_interior_containment_amendment.eligibility: authoritative selected track with finite signed per-face motion, current trusted-interior membership, and projected relaxation risk
trusted_interior_containment_amendment.objective: maximize the minimum current opposing-face clearance on the parent-cell lattice

limitations: All numerical thresholds, geometry, aperture, and measurement cadence are inherited byte-for-byte from the immutable v5 policy chain.
No metric value from the invalid v5 moving candidate was inspected or used to alter a threshold.
Trusted-interior containment does not admit a current relaxation-zone entry and does not waive ambiguity, topology, shift-cap, parent-containment, or finite-evidence checks.
A pass remains a bounded same-equation fixed-aperture comparison, not CM1, observational, ensemble, climatological, retired-swath precipitation, or storm-lifetime validation.
The policy does not enable public moving_nest selection, live-storm Vulkan, device-resident relocation, terrain, throughput, or broader physics combinations.
